levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Skeleton is missing one or more of the six required sections, or sections contain only placeholders with no real content.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All six required sections are present and each contains at least one specific piece of real content pulled from earlier units.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All six sections are present with specific content, and the learner has flagged which sections still need more work later in this unit.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Content pulled forward is vague or doesn't clearly trace back to a specific unit 1-5 artifact or decision.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three sections cite a specific, identifiable prior artifact or decision (for example, 'Unit 1 pathway shortlist' or 'Unit 4 housing comparison').

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner accurately identifies where earlier work conflicts or needs updating rather than just copying it forward unchanged.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a section as unfinished with no reasoning given.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection identifies a specific section with the least real content and explains why.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection connects the identified gap to a concrete next step planned for later in the unit.

lookFors: The skeleton has a clearly labeled section for each of the six required plan parts.
Content pulled forward is specific and traceable to real unit 1-5 work, not invented on the spot.
No real household financial figures or private health or legal detail appear in the sections.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
